specialists.description: Mandatory read-only gate before any ILSpy/ilspycmd or Ghidra work on EXE, DLL, ELF, firmware or game-client binaries. Use whenever the user wants to decompile, disassemble or analyze a binary, asks if ILSpy or Ghidra is ready, or is about to install them, even if they never say "preflight".
